description:
Hushfacebook v0.12.0 targets Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This release gathers everything since v0.11.0 and still brings 88 patches for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54. New switches leave calls and chat notifications to Messenger, keep the top bar and the tab bar on screen while you scroll, let a tap on a reel's progress bar seek, and take Muse out of the share sheet. The settings home page gets Quick setups and a Report a problem row, and a setting that needs a restart now shows a row that restarts Facebook and brings you back to the same page. You can name the patched app when you patch, and Pick an app icon opens Facebook's App icon page on accounts where Facebook doesn't list it. The kept progress bar shows on every reel and stays where you drag it, and the Reported issues list below maps each report this release touches.

Built by GitHub Actions from commit 21a8f5629612, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, build 475417104, or its 32-bit build 475417036. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
